content: {"episode_id":"ep-05057","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10). The monitoring is medically necessary to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate the patient's symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting. Because these events are intermittent, extended mobile telemetry is the appropriate means of documenting the arrhythmia and guiding management. We therefore request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial and payment of the outstanding balance of 702.81."}
